title: Agent access receipt
description: The minimal append-only record that recovered every missed detection in this study. Five fields per file operation. Contents are deliberately NOT retained: the receipt records that an access happened, not what was in the file.

actor.description: Identity of the agent performing the operation.

event.description: Operation class. Extend per platform; keep the vocabulary closed.

resource.description: Path or identifier of the resource touched. No contents.

outcome.description: Whether the operation succeeded. A failed read is NOT an access.
